name: Frandovínez (Spain)
description: White field with two red diagonal stripes from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Frandovínez (a lion, a chequy field and a tower above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Frandovínez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
